title: A gate about the token counts of a model run (tokens per correct answer, input and output tokens) is classed secrets
goal: A gate whose only token word counts a model's tokens (tokens per answer, input tokens, cache tokens, a token budget) is classed by its other words and not as secrets, while a gate naming an API token, GITLAB_TOKEN or a credential file stays secrets

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;it={'touches':['_tools/bench_report.py']};qs=['Show tokens per correct answer in the report?','Sum input, output and cache tokens in the multi table?'];r=[a.class_reasons(it,dict(id='g1',question=q,options=['one','two']))[0] for q in qs];print(r);sys.exit(0 if 'secrets' not in r else 1)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import bl_authority as a
def cl(q,t):return a.class_reasons({"touches":t},{"id":"g1","question":q,"options":["one","two"]})[0]
counts=[cl(q,["_tools/bench_report.py"]) for q in ("Show tokens per correct answer in the report?","Sum input, output and cache tokens in the multi table?","Is a token budget per run kept in the report?","Show cache tokens beside the input tokens?")]
real=[cl(q,["_tools/bench_report.py"]) for q in ("Rotate the API token of the service account?","Where is the GITLAB_TOKEN kept?","Store the credential file in _private?")]
print("token count gates:",counts,"| API token and credential gates:",real)
sys.exit(0 if "secrets" not in counts and all(r=="secrets" for r in real) else 1)
